zh: 杯子滑了一下，不小心打翻了。
old_en: The cup slipped and accidentally spilled over.
new_en: The cup slipped and fell over by accident.

zh: 桌子不平，杯子不小心翻了。
old_en: The table was uneven, causing the cup to accidentally tip over.
new_en: The table was uneven, so the cup fell over by accident.

zh: 他误把盐当成了糖。
old_en: He accidentally mixed salt with sugar.
new_en: He mistook salt for sugar by accident.

zh: 我不小心把糖撒了一地。
old_en: I accidentally spilled sugar all over the floor.
new_en: I accidentally spilled sugar all over the floor.

zh: 文件不小心被他删掉了。
old_en: The file was accidentally deleted.
new_en: He accidentally deleted the file.

zh: 他不小心删掉了那个重要文件。
old_en: He accidentally deleted that important document.
new_en: He accidentally deleted that important document.

zh: 我故意留了一盏灯，等家人回来。
old_en: I left the light on purpose to keep the room bright.
new_en: I left a light on purpose to wait for my family.

zh: 她故意留了一盏灯，怕我回来时太黑。
old_en: She left the light on purpose to avoid it being too dark when I returned.
new_en: She left a light on purpose in case it was too dark when I got back.

zh: 他说的时候不小心说漏了嘴，把秘密告诉了好朋友。
old_en: He accidentally let slip the secret to his friend when talking.
new_en: He accidentally spilled the beans about the secret to his good friend while talking.

zh: 他本来不想说的，但不小心说出了那个秘密。
old_en: He accidentally revealed the secret despite not intending to.
new_en: He didn't mean to, but he accidentally let out the secret.

zh: 我故意早点到，想占一个好座位。
old_en: I arrived early on purpose to secure a good seat.
new_en: I got here early on purpose to grab a good seat.

zh: 他故意晚一点走，想避开高峰。
old_en: He left late on purpose to avoid the rush hour.
new_en: He left late on purpose to dodge the rush hour.

zh: 他不小心坐过站了，现在不知道该怎么办。
old_en: He accidentally missed his stop, now unsure what to do.
new_en: He missed his stop by accident and now he's not sure what to do.

zh: 他故意不说话，让大家觉得奇怪。
old_en: He spoke on purpose, making everyone feel curious.
new_en: He stayed silent on purpose to make everyone feel weird.

zh: 他刚才是故意不理我吗？
old_en: Was he just ignoring me on purpose or by mistake?
new_en: Was he ignoring me on purpose just now?

zh: 他不是故意迟到的，只是路上堵车了。
old_en: He wasn't late on purpose, just because of the traffic jam.
new_en: He didn't mean to be late, the traffic jam made him late.

zh: 她不是故意不来的，因为家里有事。
old_en: She didn't come on purpose, but because of family matters.
new_en: She didn't come on purpose; she had family matters to attend to.

zh: 他故意绕远路，想多看一会儿风景。
old_en: He deliberately took a longer route, on purpose to have more time to admire the scenery.
new_en: He took a longer route on purpose to see more of the scenery.

zh: 我故意绕开人群，想安静地走一走。
old_en: I walked on purpose away from the crowd to have some peace and quiet.
new_en: I walked away from the crowd on purpose to have some peace and quiet.

zh: 朋友不小心坐过了两站，下车后急急忙忙地跑回去。
old_en: The friend accidentally sat past two stops and hurriedly got off to go back.
new_en: The friend sat past two stops by accident and ran back after getting off.
